title: Multiphase Clock
source_docs: DSP System Toolbox/Signal Management/Switches and Counters/Multiphase_Clock.md
text: 生成多个二进制时钟信号；输出 1 路；{Clock frequency (Hz)} 指定所有时钟信号的频率、{Number of phases, N} 输出向量中的相位数、{Starting phase (1 to N)} 指定起始相位的向量索引、{Number of phase intervals over which clock is active (1 to N-1)} 指定每个输出的活动电平持续时间、{Active level (polarity)} 指定 Active level High、{Output data type} 输出数据类型，按实例取值。

params.name: Clock frequency (Hz)
params.values: 所有时钟信号的频率 1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Number of phases, N
params.values: 输出向量中的相位数 4 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Starting phase (1 to N)
params.values: 起始相位的向量索引 1 (default) | integer from 1 to N

params.name: Number of phase intervals over which clock is active (1 to N-1)
params.values: 每个输出的活动电平持续时间 3 (default) | integer from 1 to N -1

params.name: Output data type
params.values: 输出数据类型 Logical (default) | Boolean
